tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anti-AI protesters disrupted an Nvidia event and rallied outside Palantir offices. Confirmed by The Guardian: rising public concern over artificial intelligence risks is driving direct action.
Reported by Martin Cid Magazine: Google DeepMind's chair and Alphabet chief scientist Demis Hassabis described the human brain as a biological approximation to a Turing machine.
Reported by Chosunbiz: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI has unveiled Beam to compete with Chinese open-weight leaders in the market.
OpenAI apologized for an Australia hack and committed to faster disclosure of such incidents. Reported by Bloomberg on the company's response to the security breach.
Reported by Finimize: DeepSeek is nearing a 12 billion dollar funding round.
Free every hour.
